# Anne Shirley & Diana Barry

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — close companions · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with flowers at church before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). In the garden, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly hit it off and vow to be lifelong bosom friends. After returning home overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a sweet gift of chocolates from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together, discussing their classmates and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). During afternoon lessons, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in fury. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she furiously refuses Gilbert's apology after school.
>

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as punishment for being late, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs up her things and refuses to return to school. Upon Mrs. Rachel Lynde's advice, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stay home and study on her own, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to hold a fierce grudge against [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while imagining a tragic future without [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) comes down with severe croup while her parents are away, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for help. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with twins to nurse [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings a doctor, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's friendship.
>

> At Diana's party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts the dare, loses her balance, and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and the doctor puts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on several weeks of bed rest.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and quickly grows fond of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities and Miss Stacy's project for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) dismisses the concert as nonsense, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warm encouragement.
>

> Noticing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacks stylish clothes like her schoolmates, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decides to give her a fashionable dress for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). After an awkward attempt to shop himself, he enlists Mrs. Lynde's help to make a brown gloria dress with puffed sleeves. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and a pair of kid slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), making her concert night a resounding success.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) present of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). They perform in the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert, which is a resounding success, and walk home together discussing their performances. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) sit by the fire and proudly express how well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) did, discussing her future education.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home to find that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has bought hair dye from a traveling peddler and accidentally turned her red hair green. When washing fails to remove the dye, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has to cut Anne's hair off completely. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deals with the shame of her shingled hair at school and vows to focus on being good rather than beautiful.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to support Anne's joining the class, which delights [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). The Queen's class is formed, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels saddened by Diana's absence and finds herself in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while privately regretting her past grudge against him.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the thrilling news that she tied for first place on the entrance examination pass list. Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) runs into the field to share her triumph with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who all praise her achievement.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) offering pragmatic advice before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md). At the hotel, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffers from severe stage fright upon facing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience, she finds her determination, delivers a successful recitation, gets encored, and is warmly praised by the guests.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives an encore performance at the concert to avoid disappointing [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), winning over the audience and guests. Afterward, she, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) share supper and reflect on the evening as [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) drives them home, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expressing contentment with her own life over rich lifestyles.
>

> While returning from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) spot a cow ruining Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing it to be her own unruly cow, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily sells the animal to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) on the spot. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) safe in her pen and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow instead.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive along the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) road to canvass for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They stop at the Andrews house, where the pessimistic [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md) refuses to give anything, but Catherine secretly runs out afterward to contribute her egg money.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their fundraising canvass, encountering various quirky neighbors including the neat freak Mrs. Theodore White and the overjoyed [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), who donates handsomely following the birth of his son. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a subscription, but he flatly refuses.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After the painter finishes, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers that the hall has been painted a glaring blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint order numbers. The news spreads, devastating the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), but the villagers rally behind the young people while blaming the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes) for the mistake.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate her spring "adopted birthday" with a picnic walk through the woods with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). On Saturday, the four girls explore new paths, name a woodland pool "[Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake)," and discover the forgotten, flower-filled garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md). Sitting among the narcissi, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the poignant story of Hester's life and death, which deeply touches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) stealing plum jam and lectures him, before learning with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins will remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until fall. Later at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent-medicine company for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit Judson to persuade him otherwise, but he smoothly refuses to change his mind.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) fail to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) to keep patent medicine ads off his fences. However, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later catches Judson accepting a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). Fearful that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will expose him and ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to drop the fence advertisements if she keeps quiet.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed after answering his curious questions about sleep and jam. Later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and tells her where they might find a willow-ware platter to replace Aunt Josephine's. The next day, the two girls drive to the Copp farm on [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally falls through the roof of a duck house while trying to look in the pantry window, leaving her stuck until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and releases her.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains her pantry intrusion to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), who serves the girls tea and agrees to sell the willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars to help fund her upcoming wedding. After leaving, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) holds her new purchase while she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss the day's adventures on their ride home.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P59](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0059), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md) while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes off with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to do chores. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is changing a feather bed, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). Despite accidentally dyeing her nose red with rug dye beforehand, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) manages to clean herself up, borrow food from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and entertain her guests with a pleasant dinner and a walk through the woods.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P20](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0020), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> At school, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) gets into a dispute over a picture drawn on a slate, while [Dora](../character/dora.md) becomes frightened of staying in the dark after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) shares stories of her family's ghosts. Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost in the woods on their way to a tea party and stumble upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There they meet the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), who invite them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> Miss Lavendar entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Charlotta the Fourth with tea and demonstrates the magical echoes around [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). After explaining the history of her succession of 'Charlottas,' Miss Lavendar is shaken when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) casually mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), the son of her former lover, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). The girls bid a warm farewell to a visibly saddened Miss Lavendar and reflect on her and their own names as they leave.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) expresses her anxieties about [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) moving away to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), including her fear of being left behind and her curiosity regarding Anne's feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reassures [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) of her enduring love and friendship, reflecting fondly on how much Diana's presence changed her life since coming to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P61](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0061)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her impending departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in the orchard before walking to the Post Office. On her way home, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her on the bridge and tries to express his deeper feelings, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cuts the moment short. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts and talks with young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) about her plans and growing up.
>
> — v3 · Chapter I The Shadow of Change

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020), [v3 ch.Change P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) attend a farewell party thrown by the A.V.I.S., where they are presented with gifts before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves for college. The next evening, after feeling discouraged by well-meaning neighbors, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk through the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), where they find a wild apple tree and enjoy a peaceful stroll together.
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), [v3 ch.Autumn P7](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0007), [v3 ch.Autumn P32](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0032)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after saying emotional goodbyes to her family and friends. She travels by boat and train alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie, eventually arriving in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) where [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) greets her and takes her to their new boarding house.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010)_

> After completing their first-term examinations at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays while [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) heads to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is joyfully welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and the twins, later helping little [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) resolve his guilt over wanting to say a bad word. Over [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from Miss Lavendar, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), and later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and notices changes, including Ruby Gillis's failing health due to illness. On their way to visit Ruby, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stop by to see the sharp-tongued [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md). Later, they visit the Gillis house, where Ruby tries to hide her illness under a facade of gaiety.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022), [v3 ch.Life P52](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0052)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) works on writing her story, "Averil's Atonement," sharing her drafts with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and receiving blunt critiques from Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After sending the completed manuscript to two different magazines and receiving rejections from both, a disheartened [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to lock the story away and abandon her literary ambitions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P28](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0028), [v3 ch.Atonement” P41](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0041), [v3 ch.Atonement” P60](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0060), [v3 ch.Atonement” P67](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0067)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a quiet evening with [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully admits her fear of dying and leaving her life behind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforts her as best she can, and the conversation deeply affects her view of life. Shortly after, Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the community to mourn her at her funeral.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIV The Summons

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their deep friendship. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) marries [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), after which [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home and they take a stroll through Lovers' Lane, talking about their summer plans and how much [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) is changing.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), who has just given birth to her baby boy, little [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md). Joined by Mrs. Allan, they talk about motherhood and childhood memories, which leaves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feeling lonely and disconnected as she walks home alone.
>
